entries.813386f60a7e12af: To realize the 'Nakayama Steel Works Group 2030 Long-Term Vision', the company is pursuing a long-term plan centered on investment in a new electric furnace. A joint venture with Nippon Steel Corporation will build and own a new electric furnace on the Funamachi Plant site and lease it to the company; the company will operate the electric furnace using the leased equipment, aiming to raise its in-house iron source ratio and strengthen cost competitiveness. With the new electric furnace in operation, the company aims to cut CO2 emissions in fiscal 2030 by 46% compared with fiscal 2013 and to achieve carbon neutrality in fiscal 2050. In parallel, the company is holding talks toward a definitive agreement on a business alliance with Yodoko Co., Ltd., aiming to expand the applications of electric-furnace steel.
